News.Subject: Log4Shell: patch now
News.Body: A critical flaw in Log4j lets attackers run code on your servers. Update to the latest version.

News.Subject: Why backups fail when you need them
News.Body: Most teams never test a restore. Schedule one this week.

News.Subject: How to spot a phishing mail
News.Body: Check the sender address letter by letter. Real IT teams never ask for your password by mail.

News.Subject: Ransomware hits 3 hospitals
News.Body: Attackers got in through an unpatched VPN. All three had no offline backup.

News.Subject: The 3-2-1 backup rule
News.Body: 3 copies of your data, on 2 different media, 1 of them off-site. Simple and still the best.

News.Subject: Why your server room needs a thermometer
News.Body: Most hardware failures in small companies start with heat. A 10 € sensor can save a server.

News.Subject: MFA blocks 99% of account attacks
News.Body: Turning on two-factor login is the cheapest security upgrade you can make.

News.Subject: CEO fraud costs companies millions
News.Body: Scammers pose as the boss and ask for urgent payments or gift cards. Always call to check.

News.Subject: Night shift tips for sysadmins
News.Body: Drink water, check alerts every 15 minutes, and write down everything you change.

News.Subject: Old disks: when to replace them
News.Body: Watch the SMART reallocated sector count. If it keeps rising, the disk is dying.
